There may be at most 4096 terminals plus internal nodes and 8192 elements. All endpoint, control, winding and ground keys must be declared. Collections reject null entries and are defensively copied.

Constructor arguments
ArgumentUnits and accepted values
terminalsnon-null immutable-copy input; unique local keys and native IDs; must match the provider geometry
internalNodesnon-null nodes with keys unique across terminals and internal nodes
elementsnon-null elements with unique IDs and declared endpoint/control/winding nodes
groundsnon-null set of declared local node keys

The complete terminal records must match ElectricalDevice.terminals() as a set. Retain terminals in an off state.

The prepared terminal collection must equal terminals() as a set: key, native ID, position and hit radius all participate. Ordering may differ. Return captured immutable inputs; do not advance history.
An empty description requires an empty geometry query. For a disabled device with wiring points, keep its terminal records and use an open ElectricalModel.Switch. A mismatch isolates the device.

WWPG constructs this event during startup. The registration sink must be non-null; null throws NullPointerException. Add-ons subscribe on their mod event bus and use register(), rather than posting their own registration event.

The original overview’s phrase “electrically inactive” is incomplete: empty() exposes no terminals, so it is valid only if ElectricalDevice.terminals() is also empty. Keep terminal records and open a switch for an ordinary disabled, wired machine.
